title: Bee Removal in Franklin Square, Long Island
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Franklin Square, Long Island. Licensed technicians treat nests in walls, attics, soffits, and ground. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Franklin Square residents facing wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, or ground bee nests need fast, professional treatment to protect their families and properties. Our licensed technicians provide complete nest treatment and removal throughout Franklin Square — from the tree-lined streets near Rath Park to the bustling commercial areas along Hempstead Turnpike. We treat nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, eaves, sheds, and the ground, locate every entry point, and seal openings to prevent recolonization.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC brings over a decade of experience serving Franklin Square and surrounding Long Island communities with reliable, affordable bee removal services. Our licensed technicians use proven methods to safely extract bee colonies, and we offer same-day service with transparent pricing from $350 to $550 with no hidden fees.
localContext: Franklin Square's mix of post-war residential homes, garden-style apartment complexes, and commercial properties along New Hyde Park Road creates ideal environments where wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets commonly build paper nests in wall voids, attics, soffits, and overhangs. The mature trees throughout neighborhoods near Wellington Road and around local landmarks like the Franklin Square Public Library provide natural shelter that brings stinging insects into contact with homes and businesses. Carpenter bees bore into fascia boards, deck posts, and wooden trim throughout the neighborhood. Ground-nesting yellow jackets establish colonies in lawns, landscaping beds, and around building foundations where foot traffic creates dangerous encounters.

faqs.question: How quickly can you treat a wasp or hornet nest in Franklin Square?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service throughout Franklin Square. Once you contact us at (855) 930-5016, we'll schedule an appointment within 24 hours in most cases. Our technicians serve all Franklin Square neighborhoods and can typically complete nest treatment, material removal, and entry-point sealing in one visit — timing depends on nest location and access.

faqs.question: What does the nest treatment and removal service include?
faqs.answer: Every service includes species identification, locating the nest and every entry point, treating the nest directly, removing accessible nest material from wall voids or other structures, sealing all openings to prevent recolonization, and a service agreement. Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Franklin Square?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Will wasps or yellow jackets return after treatment?
faqs.answer: Once the nest is treated and all entry points are sealed, that colony cannot return. Sealing every opening is critical — wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets will reuse accessible cavities if given the chance. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
